supersedes_scope: The earlier design left Linux dependency installation as diagnosis; dependency supply and first-run setup are now required product responsibilities on both supported platforms.

source_findings.finding: Pi installers can supply Node when needed.
Read-NodeNpmInstallChoice and Read-GitBashInstallChoice offer managed Node/Portable Git installation; Install-GitBashStandalone sets shellPath.
source_findings.scope: Online script read on 2026-10-08, not attributed to the pinned repository commit; never executed. Optional local snapshot download returned HTTP 403, so no local raw copy is claimed.

source_findings.finding: Pi works on the local machine by default and recommends an external sandbox/container for untrusted or unattended tasks.
The documented npm entry requires installing Node first.
Platform backends are selected automatically; unavailable backends fail closed and Windows enforcement is partial.
Application profiles can permit required unprivileged user namespaces; a ForgeCode-specific profile still needs native validation.

local_findings: apps/desktop/forge.config.ts currently has no explicit sandbox package dependency list in its deb options.
forge/tools/patch.py and forge/tools/git.py invoke external Git; forge/application/workspaces.py resolves Git with shutil.which. Core Git supply belongs in the product installation scope.

decision.windows: Bundle locked application runtimes, PowerShell, core Git/ripgrep; integrate existing broker and verification into first use.
decision.linux: Declare system packages in deb, include application helpers/runtimes and manage app-specific configuration in the installation flow.
decision.acceptance: On supported default desktops, only ForgeCode installation, normal OS authorization, model configuration and project selection precede the first confined file/Shell/Git task; manual dependency or configuration steps fail acceptance.
decision.network: Normal online installation may obtain declared OS packages; a fully offline dependency repository is not promised.
decision.project_toolchains: Project-specific SDKs remain separate; core Git is not classified as a project-only dependency.

checks.name: scripts.quality.check_project
checks.scope: Offline syntax/locks/graph/refs/workflows/secret patterns only; not the four-command registered quality suite or behavior regression

verification_scope: Documentation revision only; previous quality and native receipts retain their original scope. No new runtime behavior is implemented or claimed.
next_work: Implement F28 S1 dependency supply/first-run flow and S2-S4 real boundary and clean-system acceptance; F31 remains the independent official Docker evaluation path.
